evidence: The films were grown mainly onto 5 cm T 5c m substrates in a hot-wall, flow-type F120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd., Helsinki, Finland) in the temperature range of 225–350 -C. La(thd)3 and TiF4 pulse times were varied from 0.2 to 4 s and 0.2 to 2 s, respectively. Nitrogen purges (0.5–1.0 s) were used after both precursor pulses.
